name: resonance
description: A local developer environment for navigating repository Markdown.

scripts.format: prettier --write src/packages/doctor/index.ts src/packages/doctor/doctor-runner.ts src/packages/doctor/doctor.test.ts src/packages/doctor/doctor-source.js src/packages/doctor/doctor.css src/packages/doctor/README.md backlog/plans/doctor-workspace.md tsconfig.json .markdownlint-cli2.yaml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src/packages/doctor/index.ts src/packages/doctor/doctor-runner.ts src/packages/doctor/doctor.test.ts src/packages/doctor/doctor-source.js src/packages/doctor/doctor.css src/packages/doctor/README.md backlog/plans/doctor-workspace.md tsconfig.json .markdownlint-cli2.yaml
scripts.lint: bun run format:check && bun run lint:markdown
scripts.build:backlog: bun build src/packages/backlog/backlog-source.js --outfile src/packages/backlog/backlog.js --target browser --format esm --minify
scripts.build:doctor: bun build src/packages/doctor/doctor-source.js --outfile src/packages/doctor/doctor.js --target browser --format esm --minify
scripts.build:browser: bun run build:backlog && bun run build:architecture && bun run build:documentation && bun run build:doctor
